abstract: A dermoid cyst, also called a benign cystic teratoma, often presents as a midline mass in the trunk or sacrococcygeal region, and more commonly in the skin of the face, forehead, and scalp. Although the ischiorectal fossa contains very few structures, a wide variety of pathological entities, such as developmental cysts, epidermoid cysts, lipomas, neurofibromas, and tailgut cysts, have been reported. Dermoid cysts in the ischiorectal fossa are rare, and very few cases have been reported in the scientific literature. This case report presents an uncommon presentation of a dermoid cyst in the ischiorectal fossa in a 25-year-old female patient.
abstract_ja: 類皮嚢腫は良性嚢胞性奇形腫とも呼ばれ、体幹や仙尾部の正中に生じる腫瘤として、より多くは顔面、前額部、頭皮の皮膚に発生することが多い。坐骨直腸窩には構造が少ないにもかかわらず、発生性嚢胞、類表皮嚢胞、脂肪腫、神経線維腫、尾腸嚢胞など多様な病変が報告されている。坐骨直腸窩の類皮嚢腫は稀であり、文献上の報告は極めて少ない。本症例報告は、25歳女性の坐骨直腸窩に生じた類皮嚢腫の、稀な提示例を記述するものである。
